notes.title: Please run Import again
notes.detail: to apply the new scheduling to cards you imported earlier, open Settings → Import and press Import once, on any one of your devices.

notes.title: The Lab on Android
notes.detail: build boards from your sources, ask about them, quiz yourself and study with the tutor.

notes.title: Chat Settings
notes.detail: choose the font and text size of the AI chat.

notes.title: Resize and move a snip
notes.detail: adjust a snip in a PDF after you have drawn it.

notes.title: What's New shows this build's changes
notes.detail: only the ones for your device, with a link to the full changelog.

notes.title: Smarter practice scheduling
notes.detail: reviews are now planned more precisely, so cards stick better, and cards imported from the web app continue right where the web left off.

notes.title: Web import brings more of your account
notes.detail: practice settings, Pomodoro sessions and note collections come over, and items in the web Trash arrive as Archived.

notes.title: Library search finds what you expect
notes.detail: it stays in the view you picked, no longer hides documents with many matching pages, and drops a document as soon as you archive it.

notes.title: Typing in Library search no longer lags
notes.detail: letters appear at once and the list stops flickering.

notes.title: Select all covers search results
notes.detail: search results get their own checkboxes.

notes.title: Notes Settings in a new layout
notes.detail: typography and layout side by side, with a reset for layout.

notes.title: Your progress is easier to read
notes.detail: star ratings line up, Highest and Lowest rating show only their own stars, custom dates apply to Acquired knowledge, and dates and hours follow your device.

notes.title: One sort order everywhere
notes.detail: untitled cards and notes always come last.

notes.title: Colours match the design on every device
notes.detail: and the streak flame has a new icon.

notes.title: Manage Tags opens at once after Select all
The PDF reader remembers each document's zoom
Chat Support finds the right guide more often
Drawing a snip no longer crashes the app
notes.detail: on some Macs, iPhones and iPads.

notes.title: Reset all data clears everything
notes.detail: folders, audio and the streak flame are cleared too.

notes.title: Import counts each item once
notes.detail: and says "All items imported" when nothing is left.

notes.title: Archived documents keep their files
Imported highlights show View Source as a chip
The manual flashcard form stays open after Save
Flashcard and note panels stay open when you reopen a document
Add to collection shows one folder icon for every collection
